title: Promotion request
description: The promotion request, as defined in The Software Field Guide, issue #80: the PR that moves one audit rule to enforce, citing its flow-evidence file — promotion is evidence, not assertion. The gate demands the evidence in hand, matched flows for the rule, and a claimed window inside the evidence's window: a PR may only claim flows its evidence actually observed. The validator additionally enforces the semantic rules a JSON schema cannot — the named rule declared and in audit mode, the target enforce, the window real and inside the evidence window, and the cited evidence showing matched flows.

pr.description: The PR that carries the promotion. Audit→enforce promotion is a PR citing evidence, not a suggestion.

rule.description: The contract rule to promote, by id. Must be declared and in audit mode — promoting a rule that is already enforced is a PR about nothing.

to.description: The target mode. Audit→enforce is the only promotion this gate models, and it says so.

evidenceFile.description: The flow-evidence file the PR cites. Without its citation the promotion fails — promotion is evidence, not assertion.

window.description: The window the PR claims. Must fall inside the window of the cited evidence — the PR may only claim flows its evidence actually observed.

from.description: The day the claimed window opened, YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: The day the claimed window closed, YYYY-MM-DD.
